stem: Dominic wishes to choose a random sample of five students from the 150 students in his year. He numbers the students from 1 to 150. Then he uses his calculator to generate five random numbers between 0 and 1. He multiplies each random number by 150 and rounds up to the next whole number to give a student number.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Dominic’s first random number is 0.392. Find the student number that is produced by this random number.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Dominic’s second student number is 104. Find a possible random number that would produce this student number.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text: Explain briefly why five random numbers may not be enough to produce a sample of five student numbers.
